s0.p1: The ⟦f0⟧ element is intended to store a markup template
s0.p2: ![ico-20 warn] **It is not displayed on the page**
s0.p3: ![ico-20 warn] **It is parsed by the browser, so it must contain only valid markup code**
s0.p4: This is a document fragment that has no parent in the DOM tree
s0.p5: A DocumentFragment contains DOM elements (nodes), just like the ⟦f1⟧ object
s0.p6: However, as a document fragment is not part of the DOM structure, it is not displayed on the page
s0.p7: This is a markup template which, if necessary, can be inserted at the right time and in the right place
